hints.content: Let's think about $\dfrac{q}{20}$ for different values of $q$.

$q$ | $\dfrac{q}{20}$ |
:-: | :-: | 
$50$ | $2.5$
$40$ | $2$
$20$ | $1$
$10$  | $0.5$
$2$ | $0.1$

Looking at the table, is $\dfrac{q}{20}$ increasing or decreasing as $q$ decreases?
